_about: Belloc's How the Reformation Happened (1928), on Pudewa's list, as an Internet Archive scan of the first edition. Added in reading-lists batch 9 (2026-10-17): books named by the Omnibus, Callihan, Kern, Pudewa, White and Stanford lists that no shelf held.

_excluded.belloc-joan-of-arc: Joan of Arc (1929): the only open Internet Archive copy (joan-of-arc-by-hilaire-belloc) is a retyped text with no title page, so its edition cannot be checked. Left out until a scan of the 1929 printing turns up.
